title: DevOps Interview Guide
description: Frontmatter schema for a single guide file under guides/<slug>.md. Guides sit above the question bank as editorial topic hubs — they reference questions dynamically by category/technology/level rather than duplicating question content. categories values must also exist in schemas/taxonomy.json.

id.description: Globally unique identifier, kebab-case. Guides are few and curated, so unlike question ids this has no numeric sequence suffix.

title.description: Guide title, used as the page H1 and the default meta title.

description.description: One to two sentences summarizing the guide's scope and audience. Feeds the meta description.

guide_type.description: Editorial emphasis, not a structural fork — every guide type shares the same schema, validator, and page template.

category.description: Primary taxonomy.json category slug for a technology-scoped guide (e.g. "kubernetes"). Omit for a domain-spanning guide with no single primary category.

categories.description: Every taxonomy.json category this guide draws its dynamic question links from. Single-item for a technology-scoped guide, multi-item for a domain-spanning one.

interview_levels.description: Which interview levels this guide is relevant to. Most guides list all 8; a role-scoped prep guide may target a subset.

featured_questions.description: A small, manually curated "must practice" list of question ids. Validated for existence against the question bank by scripts/validate-guides.ts. This is deliberately not exhaustive — the Practice Questions section is populated dynamically from `categories`/`technologies` at render time.

related_guides.description: Ids of other guides. Validated for existence and non-self-reference by scripts/validate-guides.ts.

related_technologies.description: Technology slugs to cross-link to (via /technologies/[slug]) beyond what's already listed in `technologies`.
